mapper.select: SELECT member.branchid, member.memberid, member.type, member.membername, member.schoolcode, member.schoolname, member.grade, member.push, member.marketing, member.accessyn FROM ttokssaemdb.member member WHERE member.memberid = #{memberid} AND member.memberpw = hex(aes_encrypt(#{memberpw},'ttokssaem_2022@'))
mapper.update:
UPDATE ttokssaemdb.member
os = #{os},
pushtoken = #{pushtoken},
WHERE memberid = #{memberid}
mapper.select: SELECT version, reviewversion, majoryn FROM ttokssaemdb.version WHERE os = #{os}
